inputs.text: This “long-delayed” 2009 agreement is being kept in limbo because the stalemate serves the people in power. The one-month ultimatum and threat of an indefinite nationwide strike after SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council meeting look like pressure being applied within a system designed to keep students and university staff paying the price while decision-makers stay insulated. Don’t assume this is just failed negotiation—the delay itself is doing useful work for someone.

output.main_topic: Alleged strategic delay of a 2009 agreement and the pressure surrounding a threatened nationwide strike
subtopics: Effects on students and university staff

central_relations.subject: threat of an indefinite nationwide strike
one-month ultimatum and threat of an indefinite nationwide strike
central_relations.object: pressure being applied within a system designed to keep students and university staff paying the price while decision-makers stay insulated
